about: Shared conformance cases for the agent chat contract v1. Byte-identical in fancy-chat-js and fancy-chat-php; each leg pins its sha256. A section lists the legs that must pass it.

cases.name: seq must be a positive integer
run id must be a string
a note stands in for an option
empty multi is not an answer
text field must be a string
a note does not count when the question allows none
an in-flight decision locks every other item
kinds outside the profile are ignored
raw echarts from an agent is refused
raw echarts from trusted server code
tool result refusal is not an error
tool result outcome outside the set
approval parts come only from server records
approval part placed by the server
an expired limit no longer pauses
pending hitl parks even between turns
working with a plan and background work
cooling ends exactly at the window
a streamed answer with thinking and a tool
thinking interleaves within one run: several blocks, in order; an inexact tool duration
a turn links to the message that started it, both ways
illegal transitions are counted and never corrupt state
an approval decided by a human and applied
a question answered only by a human, and a withdrawn approval
edit and resend supersedes, retract hides, queue then unsend
a reset replaces state from its snapshot
plan updates replace the run's plan, non-text deltas replace the part
an undo window is reverted only by a human, and closes once
edit and resend records the superseded branch for the host's policy
a tool result carries its output inline: text, code, and a failure's own words
a message taken as a typed decision is marked decided, never delivered
a held plan step releases only through its approval
a malformed plan step is counted illegal, never thrown on, and the cursor moves past it
an exact phrase approves with the once option, never always
case, width, spacing and trailing punctuation are normalised
a phrase inside a sentence is not a decision
a near miss is not a decision
another locale's phrase does not match
off unless the app enables it
no phrases until the host sets them
only a pending approval can be typed at
no once option of that decision means no match
time left in an open window
at the deadline the window is shut
a committed action cannot be reverted
a deadline with no zone is shut, never read as local time
an unreadable deadline is shut, never open
a held step released after its approval
a held step cannot run while its approval is pending
nor while it is being decided
a held step with no approval cannot be released
a rejected step may only be skipped or failed
a withdrawn step cannot be done
swapping the approval id does not release it
dropping a held step releases nothing
a step may become held, and staying held is fine
a null step is refused, never thrown on
a step that is not an object is refused

branchTurns.about: Under the truncate policy the server cancels every UNSETTLED turn the removed branch references: through a message in the branch (the superseded message included) or an approval placed in it. Settled turns and turns outside the branch are left alone.

cases.name: parked turns in the branch, through a message (the superseded one included) or an approval; never a settled one or one outside
a message with no branch cancels nothing
a gap is held and reported
the gap fills and the held events release in order
a reset jumps the cursor and discards held events at or below it
